content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect implementation of the "ethtool --set-eee tx-timer" command, which was previously setting the LPI TW timer duration instead of the intended EEE LPI timer. This misconfiguration led to improper handling of the Energy Efficient Ethernet (EEE) timers, resulting in the device not functioning as expected in idle mode prior to asserting its Tx LPI. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the tx-timer properly configures the EEE LPI timer while using a default value for the LPI TW timer.
